annotation: 2026-09-12 14:42 loaded-bog audit: reads conditioned B438 and scalar at 76014, multiplies them, clamps via 24C0 and publishes base pulse B82C (microseconds). Captured v2 fd795813 uses 3266.667236 us per g/rev; sustained P21 gross durations track B438 * scalar * B7DC plus approximately 0.7 ms residual. Residual is not measured injector latency; multiplicative terms, quantization and sample timing remain. This routine has no AVLS or 3000-RPM fuel step. Physical fuel delivery and the loaded misfire remain unproven by this calculation.
